injuries.name: Blake Treinen
injuries.label: 15-Day-IL
injuries.note: President of baseball operations Andrew Friedman said Saturday that Treinen (shoulder) hasn't been ruled out for a return in the postseason, Jon Paul Hoornstra of Newsweek.com reports.

injuries.name: Will Klein
injuries.label: 60-Day-IL
injuries.note: Klein (elbow) threw live batting practice Tuesday, Fabian Ardaya of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Eric Lauer
injuries.label: 60-Day-IL
injuries.note: The Dodgers transferred Lauer (elbow) to the 60-day injured list Friday, David Vassegh of AM 570 LA Sports reports.

injuries.name: Gavin Stone
injuries.label: 60-Day-IL
injuries.note: Stone (shoulder/biceps) resumed his rehab assignment with Triple-A Oklahoma City on Wednesday, allowing three runs over two-thirds of an inning.

injuries.name: Jake Cousins
injuries.label: 60-Day-IL
injuries.note: Cousins (elbow) began a rehab assignment with Triple-A Oklahoma City on Wednesday, striking out one and issuing one walk in a scoreless frame.

injuries.name: Ben Casparius
injuries.label: 60-Day-IL
injuries.note: Casparius (shoulder) experienced arm fatigue while on a minor-league rehab assignment and has been shut down from throwing, MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Brusdar Graterol
injuries.label: 60-Day-IL
injuries.note: Graterol (shoulder) underwent surgery recently for a back injury he suffered while on a rehab assignment, Jack Harris of the California Post reports.

injuries.name: Martin Perez
injuries.label: 15-Day-IL
injuries.note: Atlanta manager Walt Weiss said Friday that Perez (back) will not be available for the NLDS against the Dodgers, Aiden Stepansky of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Bryce Elder
injuries.label: 15-Day-IL
injuries.note: Atlanta manager Walt Weiss said Friday that Elder (knee) will not be available for the NLDS against the Dodgers, Aiden Stepansky of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Hurston Waldrep
injuries.label: 60-Day-IL
injuries.note: Atlanta recalled Waldrep (elbow) from Triple-A Gwinnett on Thursday and placed him on the 60-day injured list.

injuries.name: Reynaldo Lopez
injuries.label: 15-Day-IL
injuries.note: Lopez (4-5) took the loss in Monday's 7-3 loss against the Cubs after allowing five runs on six hits and two walks with two strikeouts over three innings. After the game, manager Walt Weiss stated that Lopez may be placed on the injured list due to a shoulder injury, Chad Bishop of The Atlanta Journal-Constitution reports.

injuries.name: Joe Jimenez
injuries.label: 60-Day-IL
injuries.note: Jimenez (knee) will begin a rehab assignment at Triple-A Gwinnett on Tuesday.

injuries.name: Spencer Strider
injuries.label: 60-Day-IL
injuries.note: Strider (elbow) is not expected to return to Atlanta's active roster before the end of this season, Mark Bowman of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Spencer Schwellenbach
injuries.label: 60-Day-IL
injuries.note: Schwellenbach will undergo season-ending surgery to repair a fracture in his right elbow, Mark Bowman of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Jurickson Profar
injuries.label: suspension
injuries.note: Profar will miss the full 2026 season after the appeal of his 162-game PED suspension was denied Thursday, Jeff Passan of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Joey Wentz
injuries.label: 60-Day-IL
injuries.note: Atlanta placed Wentz (knee) on the 60-day injured list Tuesday.
